# Orbit 2 — repository instructions for GitHub Copilot

Before substantive work on any repository task, read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and follow the [mandatory initialization protocol](../docs/agents/contributor-instructions.md#mandatory-initialization). This applies to research, planning, review, implementation and delegated work.

The [canonical contributor instructions](../docs/agents/contributor-instructions.md) govern task routing, verification and handoffs. Do not bulk-load unrelated documentation or duplicate policy here.
